page=canvas(size=(90 mm,70 mm),background="#ffffff")
body=text(spans=[span("Red words ",color="#ff0000"),span("Blue words and another line",color="#0000ff",font_size=9 pt)],font_family="/workspace/LayMesh/examples/assets/DejaVuSans.ttf",font_size=8 pt,align=center)
narrow=page.add(body,size=(22 mm, auto),target=page.top_left,offset=(3 mm,3 mm))
wide=page.add(body,size=(55 mm, auto),target=narrow.bottom_left,offset=(0 mm,2 mm))
